sender.en: Buyer on Marketplace or social media

name.es: “Ya te transferí”: el comprobante falso al vender
name.en: “I already transferred it”: the fake transfer receipt when you sell

how.es: Vendes algo por Marketplace o redes y aparece un comprador apurado. Te manda una captura o un comprobante de transferencia que se ve real, hecho con una app falsa, y dice que un repartidor pasa a retirar el producto. La plata nunca llega a tu cuenta. Con autos, incluso simulan vales vista o cheques.
how.en: You sell something on Marketplace or social media and a buyer in a hurry appears. They send a screenshot or transfer receipt that looks real, made with a fake app, and say a courier will pick up the item. The money never reaches your account. With cars they even fake bank drafts or cheques.

text.es: Un comprador acepta el precio sin regatear y está apurado.
text.en: A buyer accepts the price without haggling and is in a hurry.

text.es: Te manda un comprobante o captura de una transferencia.
text.en: They send you a receipt or screenshot of a transfer.

text.es: Manda a un repartidor o a un tercero a retirar antes de que revises tu cuenta.
text.en: They send a courier or someone else to collect before you check your account.

text.es: Listo, te hice la transferencia por los $380.000, te mando el comprobante. A veces el banco demora un rato en reflejarla. En 20 minutos pasa un motorista a retirar la consola, ¿me confirmas la dirección?
text.en: Done, I made the transfer for the 380,000 pesos, here’s the receipt. Sometimes the bank takes a while to show it. A motorbike courier will pick up the console in 20 minutes, can you confirm the address?

es: mando a otra persona a retirar
en: buyer sent a screenshot of the payment
courier came to pick up the item
sold on marketplace and never got paid

es: Un comprobante o captura no prueba que te pagaron.
Te mandan a un tercero a retirar, sin conocerte.
en: A receipt or screenshot doesn’t prove you were paid.
“The bank takes a while to show it”.
They send someone else to collect, without meeting you.

es: No entregues nada hasta ver la plata abonada en tu cartola, entrando tú a la app o la página del banco.
Si te estafaron, guarda los chats y denuncia en la PDI.
en: Don’t hand anything over until you see the money in your statement, checking in your bank’s app or site yourself.
If you were scammed, keep the chats and report it to the PDI.
